title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and collection policies for Intune-protected mobile apps
summary: Hold: the briefing says the roles for managing mobile DLP policies are undocumented, overlooking Microsoft's published permissions for creating and deploying DLP policies generally. The roadmap facts and existing Intune controls are supported; searches found no documentation of the mobile integration's specific configuration, default or licensing.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Purview DLP capability for Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.
claims.quote: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The planned capability evaluates clipboard actions against content-aware Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed.
claims.quote: This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed

claims.claim: The roadmap also plans collection policies to govern sensitive data handling in mobile apps.
claims.quote: Additionally, Microsoft Purview Collection policies can be used to govern how sensitive data is being handled in mobile apps.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Cost and licensing; changes
claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe this mobile Purview integration.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview DLP Intune MAM protected mobile apps clipboard collection policies default licensing prerequisites roles; Purview MAM iOS DLP. Opened DLP overview, collection overview/reference and Purview Graph overview; results concern existing mobile MAM or desktop/browser DLP.

claims.claim: The collection policy reference lists Devices, Copilot experiences, Enterprise AI, Unmanaged cloud apps and Adaptive app scopes as data sources.
claims.quote: The following data sources are supported: ... Devices ... Copilot experiences ... Enterprise AI ... Unmanaged cloud apps ... Adaptive app scopes

claims.claim: The collection policy reference does not list a mobile managed-app data source.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview DLP Intune MAM protected mobile apps clipboard collection policies; read collection-policies-policy-reference Data sources table in full. Devices is Windows; other rows cover Copilot, Enterprise AI, unmanaged cloud apps and adaptive app scopes, not mobile MAM apps.

claims.claim: The DLP overview's locations list has no Intune-managed mobile app entry.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Intune mobile clipboard DLP policy admin portal location PowerShell IntuneLocation. Read dlp-learn-about-dlp Enterprise applications and devices and Inline web traffic; neither lists Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.

claims.claim: How DLP and collection policies integrate with mobile MAM apps is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview MAM iOS DLP; Purview DLP Intune MAM protected mobile apps clipboard collection policies default licensing prerequisites roles. Opened collection overview/reference, DLP overview and Graph data security overview; none describes the mobile integration.

claims.claim: The Intune path is Apps > Protection > Create policy > iOS/iPadOS > Basics > Apps > Data protection > Restrict cut, copy and paste between other apps.
claims.quote: Select Apps > Protection. ... Select Create policy and select either iOS/iPadOS or Android. ... On the Basics page ... display the Apps page ... display the Data protection page. ... iOS/iPadOS data protection ... ref-settings-ios#data-protection

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Intune's Restrict cut, copy and paste between other apps setting controls clipboard sharing between policy-managed apps and other apps.
claims.quote: Restrict cut, copy and paste between other apps | Specify when cut, copy, and paste actions can be used with this app. ... Blocked: Don't allow cut, copy, and paste actions between this app and any other app.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections creates an iOS/iPadOS protection policy with allowedOutboundClipboardSharingLevel controlling clipboard sharing.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections ... allowedOutboundClipboardSharingLevel ... The level to which the clipboard may be shared between apps on the managed device.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented Intune row is an existing app protection control, not documented automation or configuration of the new Purview integration.
claims.quote: Create a new iosManagedAppProtection object. ... allowedOutboundClipboardSharingLevel ... The level to which the clipboard may be shared between apps on the managed device.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn does not state whether mobile Purview DLP reads, changes or overrides the Intune clipboard setting, or which policy wins a conflict.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Intune clipboard precedence mobile identity; Purview Intune mobile clipboard DLP policy admin portal location PowerShell IntuneLocation. Opened Intune policy creation/settings, DLP overview and Graph overview; found no mobile integration precedence or override rule.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies opens the Purview collection policy list, with + Create policy and + Add activities used for configuration.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Purview portal, select Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies.
claims.fix: The printed route correctly reaches the policy list but stops before the activity control. Extend it to 'Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies > + Create policy > + Add activities'; retain the list-versus-configuration distinction in the note. The creation and activity steps are at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-create-deploy-policy; conditions are optional per https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-policy-reference.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation is documented for configuring collection policy event selection.
claims.quote: Searched: collection policies PowerShell; Purview collection New-CollectionPolicy; collection policies Graph create policy API; collection policies New-Dlp. Opened collection creation/reference, New-DlpCompliancePolicy and Graph overview; Graph evaluates policies rather than configuring them.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Collection policies select collected events rather than enforce blocks on the underlying information.
claims.quote: Collection policies ... fine-tune what are the signals and data that are available to Purview solutions at the tenant level. ... Collection Policies are designed to streamline discovery of relevant information rather than to apply enforcement on that information.

claims.claim: Purview DLP policies are administered in the Purview portal, whereas the existing app protection policy is administered in Intune.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. DLP policies contain DLP rules that identify, monitor, and protect sensitive information.

claims.claim: Purview provides results for reviewing DLP and collection policy activity.
claims.quote: You can view network sensitive data matches in two Purview tools: Activity explorer in Data loss prevention; Data Security Posture Management (DSPM).

claims.claim: Intune app protection reports can be reviewed.
claims.quote: You can monitor the status of the app protection policies that you applied to users from the Intune app protection pane in Intune. Additionally, you can find information about the users affected by app protection policies, policy compliance status, and any issues
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/app-management/protection/monitor-policies for the recommendation to compare results with Intune app protection reports.
